name: Inference & Optimization
oneLiner: Running trained models quickly and cheaply for real users: serving, APIs, compression and caching.

analogy.text: A restaurant kitchen during service: the recipe is fixed, and now it's about getting many plates out fast and affordably.
analogy.breaks: A kitchen cooks each order separately. Inference servers push many users' requests through the same model step together to use the hardware efficiently.

givesAbove: A fast, affordable endpoint: send text in, get text out.
needsBelow: Model weights from Foundation Models and serving hardware from Cloud & Infrastructure.

walkthrough.title: A coding question goes out
walkthrough.text: A coding tool sends “why does this test fail?” to a model API, perhaps through a router that picks a provider, and pays per token.

walkthrough.title: The provider shares the work
walkthrough.text: On the provider's servers the question rides in a batch with many other users' requests, and the KV cache saves re-reading the long code file for every new token.

walkthrough.title: Smaller numbers, more room
walkthrough.text: Quantized weights take less memory, leaving room for more users' caches in each batch.

walkthrough.title: Or ask the same question at home
walkthrough.text: The same open model, quantized into a GGUF file, runs in a local runtime on a home GPU. The coding tool just points at localhost instead.

walkthrough.title: A small helper speeds it up
walkthrough.text: With only one user at home, a small draft model guesses ahead and the big model checks its guesses, so the answer streams out sooner with nothing changed.
